Telangana is seeking Maharashtra's approval for a Full Reservoir Level of 152 metres, while Maharashtra has raised concerns over the possible submergence of villages.

candidates.title: Revanth To Meet Maha CM On Oct 26 Over Tummidihatti Project
candidates.excerpt: Telangana Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy will meet his Maharashtra counterpart Devendra Fadnavis on Monday to resolve clearance issues over the proposed Tummidihatti barrage.

candidates.title: CID Raids Several Rice Mills in Nizamabad District, Four Arrested
candidates.excerpt: Officials suspect that some mill owners allegedly diverted government-supplied paddy instead of processing it as required. Irregularities have also been suspected in the quantity and quality of rice supplied to the government. In some cases, allegations have emerged that coarse rice was supplied instead of fine rice.
